entries.subject: Farkas-Takacs et al. K2 light curve and size constraints
entries.finding: K2 variability and the 157 (+23/−15) km thermophysical diameter constrain the selected minimum-elongation model. Minimum elongation assumes uniform reflectivity and an equator-on view. Equal short axes, volume normalization, pole, spin sense and meridian remain display assumptions; no resolved surface or unique three-dimensional shape is established.

entries.subject: 2023 Uranian irregular-satellites physical summary and occultation prospects
entries.finding: The inspected 2023 physical summary supplies comparison context for the selected light-curve and size interpretation. Its predicted occultation prospects are not measured silhouettes or terrain.

entries.subject: Maris et al. VLT irregular-moon photometry
entries.finding: The historical review records independent colors and variability, but not a unique shape inversion or spatially registered surface measurement.
